content.text: Purpose

This policy applies to all {{COMPANY}} systems, networks, facilities, data and personnel (including contractors and service providers) within the assessment scope, covering both information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) where present.
Policy

IR: Goal 2 - Incidents are analyzed and correlated to determine a response
IR: Goal 3 - Incident response is implemented

name: Service Continuity Management Policy (CISA Cyber Resilience Review (CRR))
description: Establishes service continuity management practices under the CISA Cyber Resilience Review (CRR) (CISA CRR, via CISA CSET v13).

content.text: Purpose

This policy establishes {{COMPANY}}'s requirements for service continuity management, following the CISA Cyber Resilience Review (CRR) (CISA CRR, via CISA CSET v13). It supports the organization's cyber resilience and any contractual, regulatory or insurance expectations that reference these practices.
Scope

This policy applies to all {{COMPANY}} systems, networks, facilities, data and personnel (including contractors and service providers) within the assessment scope, covering both information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) where present.
Policy
{{COMPANY}} shall implement and maintain the following service continuity management practices:
SCM: Goal 1 - Service continuity plans for high-value services are developed
SCM: Goal 2 - Service continuity plans are reviewed to resolve conflicts between plans
SCM: Goal 3 - Service continuity plans are tested to ensure they meet their stated objectives
SCM: Goal 4 - Service continuity plans are executed and reviewed
SCM: MIL2 - Planned
SCM: MIL3 - Managed
SCM: MIL4 - Measured
SCM: MIL5 - Defined
Roles and Responsibilities

The cybersecurity lead owns this policy and its supporting procedures. System and process owners implement the practices for their systems. All personnel comply with this policy and report suspected violations. The compliance function retains evidence of implementation.
Compliance Measurement

Compliance is verified through the evidence tasks linked to each control, periodic self-assessment against the CISA Cyber Resilience Review (CRR), and external assessments. Results and gaps are recorded in the risk mitigation plan.
Exceptions
Exceptions require a documented risk acceptance approved by the cybersecurity lead, a compensating control where one exists, and a review date.
Non-Compliance
Violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.
Review
This policy is reviewed at least annually and upon significant changes to systems, operations or the referenced guidance.
